## Core Features at a Glance

We evaluated 10 free project management tools based on task boards, Gantt charts, time tracking, collaboration limits, storage, and cross-platform support. All tools offer a genuinely free tier, but each has its own constraints.

## Detailed Comparison and Hidden Limits


![Project management tools with kanban boards and task lists](https://img.select.cheap/对比评测-便宜工具/select-cheap-10-guide-2026-08-06-0bc68d62ce-image-01-2026-1880x1253.jpg)

### Tool 1
- **Core features**: Task board, Gantt chart, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 10 users.
- **Storage**: 5 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, iOS, Android.
- **Hidden limit**: Free plan lacks advanced reporting.

### Tool 2
- **Core features**: Task board, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 5 users.
- **Storage**: 2 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, desktop apps.
- **Hidden limit**: Gantt chart is not available on free plan.

### Tool 3
- **Core features**: Task board, Gantt chart.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 15 users.
- **Storage**: 10 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, iOS, Android, Windows.
- **Hidden limit**: Time tracking requires manual entry.

### Tool 4
- **Core features**: Task board, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 20 users.
- **Storage**: 1 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, mobile web.
- **Hidden limit**: Gantt chart is not offered.

### Tool 5
- **Core features**: Task board, Gantt chart, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 12 users.
- **Storage**: 3 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, iOS, Android.
- **Hidden limit**: Free plan includes ads.

### Tool 6
- **Core features**: Task board.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 8 users.
- **Storage**: 1 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, Android.
- **Hidden limit**: No Gantt chart or time tracking.

### Tool 7
- **Core features**: Task board, Gantt chart.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 10 users.
- **Storage**: 2 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, iOS, Android.
- **Hidden limit**: Time tracking is limited to 5 tasks per project.

### Tool 8
- **Core features**: Task board, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 6 users.
- **Storage**: 1 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, desktop apps.
- **Hidden limit**: Gantt chart is not available.

### Tool 9
- **Core features**: Task board, Gantt chart, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 25 users.
- **Storage**: 2 GB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, iOS, Android, Linux.
- **Hidden limit**: Advanced features require paid add-on.

### Tool 10
- **Core features**: Task board, time tracking.
- **Collaboration limit**: Up to 3 users.
- **Storage**: 100 MB.
- **Cross-platform**: Web, iOS.
- **Hidden limit**: Very small storage; Gantt chart only in paid version.

## Best Choices by Scenario

- **For freelancers needing time tracking**: Tool 1, Tool 4, or Tool 8 offer time tracking with moderate limits.
- **For small teams needing Gantt charts**: Tool 3, Tool 7, or Tool 9 include Gantt charts on free plans.
- **For students with minimal storage needs**: Tool 10 might work for simple task lists but is limited in storage.

## FAQ

**Which free tool has the highest user limit?**  
Tool 9 allows up to 25 users on its free plan.

**Do any free plans include Gantt charts?**  
Yes, Tool 1, Tool 3, Tool 7, and Tool 9 offer Gantt charts on their free tiers.

**Can I track time on all these tools?**  
No, Tool 6 and Tool 8 do not offer time tracking on their free plans.

**What is the storage limit on the most restrictive plan?**  
Tool 10 offers only 100 MB of storage.

**Are these tools cross-platform?**  
Most offer web and mobile apps, but desktop availability varies. Tool 6 and Tool 10 lack desktop support.
